caveats: ACTIVE is evidence that the address signed or authorised something under a verified token's implementation. It is not evidence that a person read a wallet interface.

The asserted observable is NOT evidence of control: the sender field of an arbitrary contract's transfer event is written by that contract. It is reported only so the distance between the two observables is visible.
An address active only AFTER its first lure delivery is counted ACTIVE but not PRIOR-ACTIVE; the ordering is what distinguishes targeting from coincidence.
The control group is addresses SEEN in the corpus, so it excludes addresses that never transacted; the comparison is against transacting addresses, not against all of 2^160.
ERC-721 sends count as activity: they equally require the private key.

control.definition: sampled addresses observed in the corpus that no lure contract ever named; the base rate of activity in the address population under the same observable

estimand: per DISTINCT ADDRESS named as a recipient by a lure contract: the share that independently sent a transfer emitted by a non-lure contract (ACTIVE), and the share whose first such send precedes their first lure delivery (PRIOR-ACTIVE). Neither is intent, identity or financial loss.
non_indexed_note: ERC-20 requires from/to to be indexed. These rows carry a Transfer topic0 with null topics, both addresses being in `data` instead, so they cannot be attributed to an address here and are excluded. Counted rather than dropped.

observable.asserted: named in the sender field of any non-lure contract's transfer; this establishes nothing about control and is reported only for contrast
observable.authenticated: sender of a NON-ZERO transfer emitted by a registry-verified token contract; under the verified implementation this requires a signature from the address or an allowance it granted
observable.lower_bound_note: an address transacting only in tokens outside the registry is not observed, so each level understates activity; the same understatement applies to the control group, so the contrast between them is unaffected

sampling.scheme: splitmix64(fnv1a(all 40 hex characters of the address)) & (K-1) == 0
sampling.why_not_rows: a row sample over-represents repeatedly named recipients, which is the population feature under study
